title: 用户态进程权限与命名空间（不读参数或环境变量）
command: count=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -r "$p/status" ] && [ -e "$p/exe" ] || continue; count=$((count+1)); if [ "$count" -gt 160 ]; then echo ENTRY_LIMIT_REACHED; break; fi; echo "PID ${p##*/}"; sed -n "/^Name:/p; /^PPid:/p; /^Uid:/p; /^Gid:/p; /^CapEff:/p; /^NoNewPrivs:/p; /^Seccomp:/p" "$p/status"; for n in exe root ns/mnt ns/net ns/user; do echo "LINK $n"; readlink "$p/$n" || :; done; done; echo PROCESS_CONTEXT_DONE
scope: 固定只读命令；目录、文本与候选项有数量/行数边界；未命中不证明不存在

title: 不同挂载命名空间中的启动入口（仅元数据）
command: seen=" "; count=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -e "$p/exe" ] || continue; ns=$(readlink "$p/ns/mnt") || continue; case "$seen" in *" $ns "*) continue ;; esac; seen="$seen$ns "; count=$((count+1)); if [ "$count" -gt 16 ]; then echo ENTRY_LIMIT_REACHED; break; fi; echo "NAMESPACE $ns PID ${p##*/}"; for n in etc/rc.local etc/inittab etc/init.d/rcS root/run.sh etc/rc.d etc/init.d etc/systemd/system; do f="$p/root/$n"; [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo "ROOT_PATH $n"; ls -ld "$f"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; wc -l "$f"; fi; done; if [ -d "$p/root/etc/rc.d" ]; then echo ENABLED_RC_LINKS; ls -la "$p/root/etc/rc.d" | sed -n "1,80p"; fi; done; echo NAMESPACE_STARTUP_DONE
scope: 固定只读命令；目录、文本与候选项有数量/行数边界；未命中不证明不存在

title: 不同命名空间的根与持久化挂载
command: seen=" "; count=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -e "$p/exe" ] || continue; ns=$(readlink "$p/ns/mnt") || continue; case "$seen" in *" $ns "*) continue ;; esac; seen="$seen$ns "; count=$((count+1)); if [ "$count" -gt 16 ]; then echo ENTRY_LIMIT_REACHED; break; fi; echo "NAMESPACE $ns PID ${p##*/}"; awk '$5=="/" || $5=="/etc" || $5=="/root" || $5=="/opt/cu/apps" || $5=="/opt/upt/apps" || $5=="/usr/plugin" || $5=="/overlay" {print}' "$p/mountinfo" | sed -n "1,40p"; done; echo NAMESPACE_ROOT_MOUNTS_DONE
scope: 固定只读命令；目录、文本与候选项有数量/行数边界；未命中不证明不存在

title: 内核运行能力白名单与 cgroup 元数据
command: cat /proc/filesystems; for f in /proc/sys/kernel/cap_last_cap /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward /proc/net/ip_tables_names /proc/self/cgroup; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; sed -n "1,30p" "$f"; done; for d in /sys/fs/cgroup /sys/class/mtd /sys/block; do echo "DIR $d"; ls -la "$d" | sed -n "1,80p"; done; echo KERNEL_FEATURES_DONE

title: 文件读取工具与存储设备元数据（不读取设备内容）
command: for app in tar gzip sha256sum hexdump od file readelf stat find base64 timeout; do echo "TOOL $app"; command -v "$app" || :; done; busybox --list | grep -E "^(cat|tar|gzip|sha256sum|hexdump|od|stat|find|base64|timeout)$"; cat /proc/partitions; ls -l /dev/mtdblock* /dev/mmcblk*; echo FILE_READ_TOOLS_DONE

title: DNS 配置存在性与网络控制工具
command: for app in curl wget nslookup ping ip iptables ip6tables nft; do echo "TOOL $app"; command -v "$app" || :; done; for f in /etc/resolv.conf /var/tmp/resolv.conf /tmp/resolv.conf /tmp/resolv.conf.auto; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; ls -l "$f"; awk '/^[[:space:]]*nameserver[[:space:]]/ {n++} END {print "NAMESERVER_ENTRY_COUNT=" n+0}' "$f"; done; echo NETWORK_ENVIRONMENT_DONE

title: 厂商 Felix 自动加载与存储字段白名单
command: for f in /usr/local/osgi/local/felix.properties /usr/local/osgi/local/osgi/felix/conf/config.properties /usr/local/osgi/local/osgi/felix/conf/felix.properties /usr/local/osgi/local/osgi/felix/config.properties /usr/local/osgi/local/osgi/felix/felix.properties /usr/local/osgi/local/osgi/felix/conf/system.properties /usr/java/conf/config.properties /usr/data/osgi/conf/config.properties; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "FILE $f"; sha256sum "$f" 2>/dev/null; awk '/^[ \t]*(org[.]osgi[.]framework[.](storage|bootdelegation|system[.]packages|security)|felix[.](auto[.](start|install|deploy[.](dir|action))|cache[.](rootdir|profile|filelimit)|bundle[.]|native[.]|startlevel[.]|log[.]level)|java[.]library[.]path)[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[ \t]*[:=]/ {print; n++; if(n==90) exit}' "$f"; fi; done; echo VENDOR_OSGI_CONFIG_DONE

title: 厂商 Java 原生执行权限白名单
command: for f in /usr/local/osgi/local/j2re/lib/security/private.policy /usr/local/osgi/local/j2re/lib/security/java.policy /usr/java/jre/lib/security/java.policy /usr/java/jre/lib/security/private.policy; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "FILE $f"; sha256sum "$f" 2>/dev/null; awk '/^[ \t]*permission[ \t]+java[.]security[.]AllPermission/ || /^[ \t]*permission[ \t]+java[.]lang[.]RuntimePermission[ \t]+"(loadLibrary[.][A-Za-z0-9_*.-]+|manageProcess|modifyThread|modifyThreadGroup|readFileDescriptor|writeFileDescriptor)"/ || /^[ \t]*permission[ \t]+java[.]io[.]FilePermission[ \t]+"(..ALL FILES..|\/(usr\/data|usr\/local\/osgi|usr\/plugin|tmp|var)[A-Za-z0-9_\/*.-]*)"/ {sub(/[ \t]*\/\/.*$/, ""); print; n++; if(n==120) exit}' "$f"; fi; done; echo VENDOR_JAVA_POLICY_DONE
